verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and share the same problems. The logo's circle is clipped at the top-left canvas edge. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' and the product's label are unreadably small. The RSVP CTA has shrunk into a pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS badges, which buries it. The reading order is jumbled: the date and venue sit far left, the headline sits in the centre, and the tagline and URL are pushed to the right. A stray red placeholder fragment sits after TASTINGS. B is only marginally better because its logo blocks are larger and read more clearly as the brand mark, while A's logo is cramped and tiny.
